risk_axes.assessment: Moderate to high: an unnecessary cell restart is reversible in minutes; a missed mass event degrades service for a cell site's subscribers; field dispatch costs a truck roll; direct customer contact and radio configuration are prohibited outright.
Restarts and notifications are reversible; field dispatch is reversible at truck-roll cost; radio configuration changes are prohibited because they are not reliably reversible at run time.
Single-cell scope per run; mass events are detected by severity and outage thresholds and route to human approval.
Escalation required at severity 85 or above, degradation above 30 percent with an active outage, any hardware suspicion, and any dispatch action.
Full case record with rule provenance; replay required for every dispatch and escalation; anomaly persistence tracked for the drift obligation.

decision_rights_ladder.condition: The action is diagnostic or a bounded recovery (validate, classify, KPI diagnostic)
The action is a cell restart within observed degradation bounds
The action notifies the NOC, escalates at high severity, or dispatches external resources

elements.name: kpi-degradation
elements.source: kpi-analytics over the affected cell's counters

elements.name: anomaly-persistence
elements.source: derived from the anomaly ticket timeline

context.snapshot_semantics: The case context is snapshotted at variant match time and referenced by a cg://case identifier; the snapshot is immutable for the duration of the run.
context.minimisation_rule: The agent receives only the context elements its current decision requires. Subscriber-identifying data is never captured; the anomaly is modelled on the cell and the counters, not on any person.

handoffs.payload: evidence bundle with proposed dispatch or escalation, triggering rule, provenance and baseline comparison
handoffs.acknowledgement: approve or reject with note, recorded in the case record

handoffs.payload: anomaly disposition summary for the shift log
handoffs.acknowledgement: shift log acknowledgement recorded in the case record

escalation_routes.evidence_bundle: full trace bundle with case context snapshot

validation_obligations: After a restart, verify the cell returns to service within the observed recovery window; on failure, the persistence clock keeps running toward the exception edge.
After dispatch, verify the crew acknowledgement arrives within the response window; on failure, escalate to the RAN operations engineer.
control.intervention: The RAN operations engineer may pause or terminate a run at any point; pause and terminate events are recorded in the case record.
control.drift_obligation: A rise in the persistence exception rate, a new workaround pattern in triage, or variant frequency shifts above 10 percent relative trigger recalibration of this AOP as a new version.
